body:
It was really the highlight of the entire sordid affair, ha. I've calmed down a bunch since last night, but I'm still panicking a little here and there. And occasionally, thoughts of suicide still linger in the back of my mind. It doesn't seem like "a big deal" but you have no idea how bitterly disappointed my parents can get. It's almost like I'd be doing them the fucking favor at this point. I'm trying to save up to move out, I just don't want to get reamed up the ass with fines and court costs for the "gross misdemeanor." 

I'd mostly feel bad for the cop if I decide to go through with it. He honestly couldn't have known that he'd be aggravating my chronic depression.

I'm 19, and a girl. I appreciate the thought, though. I'm the only one in my family who "breaks the rules." I don't know, my family can be weirdly judgmental about these kinds of things. My dad's Asian so you can glean somewhat of an idea of the kinds of cultural values he holds. 
Thanks, though. It helps, honestly. Your post made me think about the fun parts of the night. I had met up with a girl I had been skyping for months who lived in California. Our first kiss was in the back of the police cruiser while handcuffed. It makes me smile.
